sentences.text: By this petition, petitioners seek directions to the respondents to acquire their lands mentioned in the proposals dated 26/03/2015 and pay them compensation.

2. Affidavit-in-reply is filed on behalf of respondent No.4 on 05/01/2026, wherein following statements are made, "Village Kumbharzhari - 40R Land:
2. ....
3. I say and submit that, after receiving the file, as per the Land Acquisition Act,
2013, Section 11(1) Notification was published on the Government Gazette January 25-31, 2024.

4. I say and submit that, as per the Land Acquisition Act, 2013, Section 19 Notification was published on the Government Gazette / December/January 26-01,
2024/2025.

sentences.text: I say and submit that as per communication received from Collector Office letter Jaa. Kra. 2025/ Bhoosampadan Samnvaya-1/Kavi-1019, dated 02.01.2026, to this office, for the publication of Final Award 6 month time extension has been given.

Village Kumbharzhari - 1 Hec. 13 R Land:
7.

I say and submit that, the proposal for land acquisition in the village Kumbharzari,
Tal. Jafrabad, Dist. Jalna for acquiring 1 Hec. 13 R of land, based on the Right To Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition, SVH 2 34-WP-12495-19.odt Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 was received from the Collector Office, Jalna by the Sub-Divisional Office, Bhokardan on 30.10.2023.
8.

entities.text: Right To Fair Compensation & Transparency in Land Acquisition, SVH 2 34-WP-12495-19.odt Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
I say and submit that after receiving the file, as per the Land Acquisition Act 2013, Section 11(1)
Notification was published in the Government Gazette March 13-19, 2025,
9.
I say and submit that, as per the Land Acquisition Act, 2013.
the file is at present in the Section 19 publication stage.

10. I say and submit that, therefore, Section 19 notification will be published within two month and after the publication of the Section 19 notification, the final award can be declared, as per the statutory provision.

Village Aland:
11.

I say and submit that, the proposal for land acquisition in the village Aaland, Tal. Jafrabad, Dist.
Jalna for acquiring 2 Hec.73 R of land, based on the Private Negotiation, was received from the Collector Office, Jalna by the Sub- Divisional Office, Bhokardan on 12.01.2023.

12. I say and submit that, the file was approved by the Private Negotiation Rate Determination Committee headed by the District Collector, Jalna District on 04.12.2024 for an amount of Rs.
1,63,80,000/-.
13.

I further say and submit that, as per the rates decided by the committee and now the deponent office already calculated the E-statement of individuals person and final amount is also calculated to be given by way of private negotiations to all the concerns.

I further say and submit that, till this date no objection has been received by the deponent office about the rates and all are ready for private negotiations award and further process of execution of sale deed is to be done by the acquiring body at their level.
The copy of E-statement and communication given to the acquiring body dated 21.02.2025 are annexed herewith and marked as EXHIBIT-R-1 Colly.
14. I say and submit that, upon receiving the fund from the Concerned acquiring agency the same will be distributed."
3. By recording the above statements as undertaking to this Court, the writ petition is disposed of.
